title: SupportedTwistPullback
statement: Use the exact and left-derived inverse images of [def-pur-compact-product-arrows] and the finite signed twists with their canonical inverse-image identifications of [lem-pur-supported-cup-functoriality]. For $p:Y\to X$, a structure map $X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $r\in\mathbb Z$, define the derived projection-pullback map from $Lp^*(A_X(r)[0])$ to $A_Y(r)[0]$ as the exact/left-derived comparison followed by the exact degree-zero comparison and the single-functor image of the canonical ordinary-etale twist pullback. First form the same composite for an arbitrary coefficient category and sheaf map $p^*S\to T$, then specialize to the recorded finite twists.
